info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Status API provides users with timely insights into the status of their credit card applications. It enables business partners and customers to query the current state of their submitted applications instantly. This API is essential for financial institutions seeking to enhance customer experience by providing transparent updates. Typical consumers include loan officers, customer service representatives, and any stakeholders involved in the credit application process.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their application. It provides insights into whether the application is in progress, approved, rejected, or under review.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of applications. This body must conform to the defined schema to ensure correct operation.

200.description: The application status request was successful.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusRequest.title: GET Request Body for Application Status
ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body structure for retrieving the application status.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusResponse.title: Application Status Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the application processing.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for referencing the application.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the application processing.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the application in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message regarding the application processing.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusResponse.description: Response object containing the status and details of the application process.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the person who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the process was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Contains audit information related to the application processing.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps clients understand the latency of the operation.
